meta.description.en: A focused two-node internal-DP template for the multi-node Recipe converter.
meta.description.zh: 用于多节点 Recipe Converter 的双节点 internal-DP 模板。

config_params.max_model_len.description.en: Maximum context length used by this template
config_params.max_model_len.description.zh: 本模板使用的最大上下文长度

config_params.max_num_seqs.description.en: Maximum concurrent sequences used by this template
config_params.max_num_seqs.description.zh: 本模板使用的最大并发序列数

config_params.gpu_memory_utilization.des.en: NPU memory fraction used by this template
config_params.gpu_memory_utilization.des.zh: 本模板使用的 NPU 内存比例

overview.en:
This standalone Recipe is the reference input for a two-node non-PD internal-DP
deployment. It intentionally contains only the script-backed scenario consumed
by the new multi-node converter.
overview.zh:
这份独立 Recipe 是双节点非 PD internal-DP 部署的参考输入，只包含新多节点
Converter 消费的 script-backed 场景，不依赖已有模型文档中的场景。

env_setup.container.A2.content.en:
Start the vLLM Ascend container on both nodes with the Ascend driver,
HCCN configuration, model cache, and two selected NPU devices mounted.
env_setup.container.A2.content.zh:
在两个节点上启动 vLLM Ascend 容器，并挂载 Ascend 驱动、HCCN 配置、
模型缓存和两个选定的 NPU 设备。

scenarios[0].steps[0].content.en:
`2-node` means a two-node non-PD deployment. API node 0 hosts internal-DP
ranks 0 and 1; Headless node 0 hosts ranks 2 and 3. Each node uses two
NPUs, giving global `DP=4` and `TP=1`. Set the API-node address and devices:

```bash
export API_NODE_0_IP="${API_NODE_0_IP:-<api_node_0_ip>}"
export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES:-0,1}"
```
scenarios[0].steps[0].content.zh:
`2-node` 表示双节点非 PD 部署。API 节点 0 承载 internal-DP rank 0、1，
Headless 节点 0 承载 rank 2、3。每个节点使用两张 NPU，全局 `DP=4`、
`TP=1`。请设置 API 节点地址和设备列表：

```bash
export API_NODE_0_IP="${API_NODE_0_IP:-<api_node_0_ip>}"
export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES="${ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES:-0,1}"
```
